summary: A 2v1 on an island map (sea in columns C-E) against thebluegecko (Cortex, base at A4). On the commander's first direction t1 opened a Hovercraft Platform (1:45) and its Goons were in his box at 3:46; by 9:00 they had killed 15 of his extractors and 7 constructors, while t2 Armada took the south land and water spots and sprinted to an advanced vehicle plant (standing 7:10). He answered with Garpikes landing on both our shores from 7:04 (Salamanders from 11:15), which cost the side 21 extractors without one raiding party paying, and with tier 2 at A4 by 9:00 (advanced vehicle plant, aircraft plant, 9 mohos, two fusions by 13:54). We led throughout (side army 4.5x what was seen at 7:00, 35-38 extractors to his 6-10 seen), but the first strike at 9:30 was seven Pincers and was pulled back; the commander gathered both seats' amphibious units under t2 by transfers (9:03, 12:03, 15:03) and signalled strike_a4 at 13:33. The joined body (37-57 units, 10.7k-16k) reached his base 15:00-16:30, killed his vehicle plant 17:39, advanced plant 17:51 and both fusions, and he resigned at 18:32 with his commander at B4 under it.

root.what: The game never left the winning path (a win); the earliest avoidable delay of the win (reader's reading): with his tier 2 just seen and many of his Garpikes on our shore, t2 sent its 7 Pincers onto his commander at 9:27 before t1's given Caymans and Garpikes reached meet_b5, against the commander's 9:03 order to gather first. The thin body bled to his commander and Salamanders, held at spot_47 from 10:30 and went back across the sea at 12:11; the body that won reached his base only at 15:00-16:30, so a 3.4-11x lead from 7:00 took until 18:32 to convert.

their_play: thebluegecko (Cortex, base A4) expanded with constructors and Exploiters to B1, B4-B5, C3-C4 and lost most of it to the Goons (15 extractors, 7 constructors, 2 Muskrats dead by 9:00). He answered across the water with Garpikes (20 seen from 4:39): landings at G5 7:04-7:48, F1 7:16, H7/H8 9:35-9:51, G1/G2 9:47-10:32, H2 11:13, H3-H6 13:18-14:20, then Salamanders (14 seen from 11:15) at G7/G8/H8 16:29-17:15; the landings took 21 of our extractors and no raiding party paid. At home: tier 2 by 9:00 (coravp; 9 mohos seen from 9:58), an aircraft plant with Shurikens by 10:00 and Valiants, two fusions by 13:54, Scorpion pop-ups at A2/A6, HLTs at A3/B4, his commander forward at B4 D-gunning our body (15:55), Tigers from 16:10 and Tzar frames by 17:48, too late. He held the trade even to 16:00 (we lost 13,900, he 13,454) on 6-10 extractors seen against our 35-38. No word from him on the game beyond 'gl hf' and 'gg wp'; our player's question at 18:35 ('what would you have done differently on our side?') has no answer in the record.

bears_on.note: Goons in his box at 3:46, first kill 4:03, 15 extractors and 7 constructors of his dead by 9:00; he held 6-10 extractors seen all game against our 35-38.
Both ways: his unguarded expansions died to Goons; our unguarded shore spots (t2: 12 of 17 losses undefended) died to Garpikes.
Goons as harass decided the early game; but 29 Goons stood idle at home at 18:00, against 'the harass units needed to not exist or be harassing'.
A 3.4-11x army lead from 7:00 was converted only at 17:30-18:30; until then the trade ran even (13,900 lost to 13,454 at 16:00) and he reached tier 2, fusions and Tzar frames.
Seven Pincers sent ahead of the given units at 9:27 bled and withdrew; the one body of both seats' units (37-57) broke the base 15:55-18:07.
From 15:55 the body was put on his commander at B4 from outside its D-gun, then on his plants (17:01) when his turret ring stalled it; he resigned with the commander alive under the body.
Our island's spots plus the water spots (side 35-38 extractors from 8:00) against his 6-10 seen carried the game despite 21 extractors lost.
Tidal generators from 5:45 (t1) and 8:40 (t2) when the wind fell to 2 (the commander at 7:33).

tools: reader's scripts over both records: side armies by minute, soldiers near his base, first sightings, kills and trade by minute
lens.caveats: No ledger row and no truth file: his numbers are floors from shared sight. The record's enemy_start intent was wrong until his base was seen ((6264,5976) for t1, (6392,408) for t2, corrected at 9:20), so minutes.py's 'his half' shares, WINDOWS and UNITS SENT sections and analyze_match's half labels are wrong; recomputed by x<4608 and distance to his base. minutes.py, analyze_match.py and floor.py read record-0 (t1) only; pro_baseline not run (Comet only; Azurite has no cards). bot.log's 'labs 0'/'cons 0' for t1 misses the hover platform and hover constructors. Rate-limit warnings at 89-90% five-hour use, no stop. The win's 'root' is the delay of the win, not a loss.

At 17:18 the armacv's armmoho order at spot_3 removed our cormex and no moho frame appeared (t1's note): the cross-faction fault, or the extractor-grid snap fixed on 2026-10-20/21 (52e985b)?
Did the wrong enemy_start intent before 9:20 shape any hands words ('toward our side', 'in their half') the players or Jev read?
Would the 9:30 strike have ended the game near 11:00 if it had waited for t1's Caymans and Garpikes and the Goons (about 3,500 west of centre at 10:00)? Reader's reading, unverified.
